info.title: The Audiologist's Toolkit
info.subtitle: Five instruments that map your hearing

rows.title: Otoscope
rows.desc: Inspects the ear canal and eardrum

rows.title: Audiometer
rows.desc: Finds the softest tones you can hear

rows.title: Tympanometer
rows.desc: Checks how the middle ear moves

rows.title: Speech testing
rows.desc: Measures how clearly you understand words

rows.title: Real-ear measurement
rows.desc: Verifies a hearing aid's real output
